comment: Scrub V1 oracle (shape D-5, rev 2.5). Every value is ONE LINE (the first), and a run of control characters is one space, never deleted (SA F-28). fn: scrub (free text — the default: a 20+ run with a digit, `_` or `-` is a token, letters-only survives) | scrub-name (a name position — frame filename, frame function, the path rule's joined scrub, and since 2026-10-18 the exception type (rev 2.6 Q-7): a run survives when it is a name — letters, or letter words joined by single `_`/`-`; a digit, a doubled or an edge separator makes it a token) | scrub-release (the release position: a run survives when it is letters-only or a lowercase hex run of a SHA's length, 7–40; anything else is a token — SA F-33) | path (scrubPathTemplate — a 16+ segment that is not a name is an id; a segment carrying a control or line terminator is an id whole). Every rule is hit at least twice; one case per permitted field is in worker.test.mjs's sentinel fixture. The name exemption is positional (owner decision 2026-10-17): the same digit-free run with a well-formed separator is `[token]` under scrub and survives under scrub-name. The credential-path markers are case-insensitive (SA F-32).
